method: Recorded browser YOLO26m inference on 100 source frames, processed with the app tracking algorithm and shared overlay renderer. Observed boxes and confidences are unmodified. IDs are assigned algorithmically. No generated motion or predicted boxes. IDs persist across brief occlusion; boxes are absent when detection is unavailable. Playback uses the source rate, not an inference-speed benchmark.
tracker: ByteTrack-style: Kalman motion, Hungarian global assignment and spatial appearance
